investigations.name: EMERGY public charging network (Borken / Coesfeld)

evidence.canonicalIdentity: EMERGY Führungs- und Servicegesellschaft mbH network serving Stadtwerke Borken and Stadtwerke Coesfeld.
evidence.currentEstateCorroboration: Bundesnetzagentur-derived 2026 register: 39 locations / 124 charge points attributed to EMERGY, including AC and 300-kW HPC.
evidence.firstPartyScope: Both Stadtwerke Borken and Stadtwerke Coesfeld current public-charging pages state the ADHOC conditions for EMERGY charging stations and describe QR scan + credit-card payment without contract.
evidence.anonymousTariff: AC 0.59 EUR/kWh gross; DC/HPC 0.69 EUR/kWh gross; 1.00 EUR gross per begun half-hour after 150 free minutes.
evidence.channelSeparation: Registered Mein Stadtwerke Strom Mobil tariff (0.35 AC / 0.45 DC-HPC plus monthly minimum volume) remains separate and is not used for anonymous_ad_hoc.

investigations.promotionBasis: Current first-party deterministic anonymous tariff rule explicitly scoped to EMERGY charging stations closes AC and DC/HPC energy plus time fee and payment semantics; no station-level extrapolation required.

backendFamilyProgress.B6: EMERGY resolved through current first-party deterministic ADHOC rule rather than opaque checkout extraction.

nextSafeAction: Continue B6 candidates with current first-party/direct anonymous tariff surfaces; prioritize a bounded estate or explicit all-network rule. Do not repeat Neustadt absent fee-scope evidence.
